AI Models

Explore Kimi's latest AI models, understand what makes each one different, and see what they can help you create, solve, and accomplish.

Kimi K3

Meet Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter model with native vision and a 1M context window. Create playable games, polished slides, interactive reports, and more.

Kimi K2.7 Code

Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model with improved long-horizon coding, stronger agent capabilities, and 30% lower thinking-token usage than K2.6.

Kimi K2.6

Kimi K2.6 is an open-source model with strong coding and agent swarm capabilities. Build pro-level websites, run workflows, and explore Claw Groups.

Kimi K2.5

Kimi K2.5 is an open source multimodal model by Moonshot AI, combining visual coding, AI agents, and agent swarm capabilities for real work.
